items.title: Meta Ads: $154.65 spend, 14 leads, $11.05 CPL — Flooring Problems Campaign
items.summary: Window widened to 2026-09-08 through 2026-09-10 (3 days) because the last successful meta-ads run (2026-09-08) only covered through 2026-09-07 and no run happened on 2026-09-09 or 2026-09-10. Over that window Meta spent $154.65, all on the sole actively-delivering campaign, Flooring Problems Campaign, generating 14 leads at $11.05 CPL — below the 7-day baseline (2026-09-04 to 2026-09-10: $345.99 / 28 leads, ~$12.36 CPL), so no anomaly. Account is ACTIVE and no ads are flagged.

needs_attention: Window widened: the most recent prior meta-ads.json is 2026-09-08, covering spend through 2026-09-07 — no meta-ads run landed for 2026-09-09 or 2026-09-10. Per policy this run widened from the standard yesterday-only pull to 3 days (2026-09-08 through 2026-09-10, within the 7-day cap) to close the gap rather than missing those two days.

Flooring Problems Campaign's raw actions again include lead-like conversion types outside the script's documented LEAD_ACTION_TYPES set (offsite_complete_registration_add_meta_leads, offsite_search_add_meta_leads, offsite_content_view_add_meta_leads — each valued at 14 in this window and 28 in the 7-day baseline, matching the counted leads exactly both times, same pattern flagged on 2026-08-31, 2026-09-02, and 2026-09-08). No discrepancy in the counted total so far, but this is a recurring hit across multiple runs — the script's lead-action set should be extended rather than continuing to hand-note it.
